comment: 从 ble_monitor（custom-components/ble_monitor，MIT）的 ble_parser 源码逐品牌提取的识别表（2026-10-11 提取，每条数值在转换器注释与 SOURCES.md 里有出处）。只收能被规则引擎表达的识别机制；靠链式 XOR 解包、cid 高字节、帧计数器、写死测试 MAC 门控的品牌（Beckett 型号层、iNode、Xiaogui、Sonoff、AltBeacon、Mocreo 型号字节层）不可表达，理由见 CANDIDATES.md。Senssun（cid 0x0100 低位注册段、碰撞风险高）主动不收。手工刷新：上游解析器大改时重读对应模块更新本表。

fleets.name: Teltonika EYE / Blue Puck sensor
fleets.notes: Teltonika EYE sensors and rebadged ELA Blue Puck/Coin sensors: company ID 0x089A (Teltonika), or broadcast names PUCK_T1 / PUCK_TH / 'C T*' / 'P T*' / 'P RHT*'. Source: ble_monitor teltonika.py (MIT).

fleets.name: ELA sensor
fleets.notes: ELA Innovation sensors (also sold rebadged as Teltonika Blue Puck/Coin): company ID 0x0757. Source: ble_monitor teltonika.py dispatch (MIT).

fleets.name: Michelin TMS tyre sensor
fleets.notes: Michelin Tyre Monitoring Sensor: company ID 0x0828 with frame-type byte 0x03/0x04 at payload offset 1. Source: ble_monitor michelin.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Acconeer XM122
fleets.notes: Acconeer radar module XM122: company ID 0xACC0, model byte 0x80 at payload offset 0. Source: ble_monitor acconeer.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Acconeer XM126
fleets.notes: Acconeer radar module XM126: company ID 0xACC0, model byte 0x90/0x91 at payload offset 0. Source: ble_monitor acconeer.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Chef iQ
fleets.notes: Chef iQ smart cooking (CQ60 probe system): company ID 0x05CD; the model itself is length-determined in the source parser, so this is a brand-level match. Source: ble_monitor chefiq.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Grundfos MI401
fleets.notes: Grundfos pump interface MI401: manufacturer block keyed 0xF214 in the source parser. Source: ble_monitor grundfos.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Hörmann Supramatic
fleets.notes: Hörmann garage-door drives (Supramatic E4 BS): company ID 0x07B4. Source: ble_monitor hormann.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Laica Smart Scale
fleets.notes: Laica body scales: manufacturer block keyed 0xA0AC in the source parser. Source: ble_monitor laica.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Mocreo sensor
fleets.notes: Mocreo temperature sensors (ST7 family): names MOCREO / ST7 / ST7-CL, or service F0FF combined with company ID 0x004A. Model-level bytes sit in the company-ID high byte in the source parser and cannot be expressed. Source: ble_monitor mocreo.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Relsib EClerk Eco
fleets.notes: Relsib EClerk Eco datalogger: service data under AA20/AA21/AA22. Source: ble_monitor relsib.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Relsib WH52
fleets.notes: Relsib WH52 thermometer: Health Thermometer (1809) service data with a 20-byte payload (length is the model discriminator in the source parser). Source: ble_monitor relsib.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Relsib WT51
fleets.notes: Relsib WT51 thermometer: Health Thermometer (1809) service data with a 10-byte payload. Source: ble_monitor relsib.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Almendo bluSensor
fleets.notes: Almendo bluSensor Mini: company ID 0x06E8. Source: ble_monitor almendo.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Air Mentor Pro 2
fleets.notes: Air Mentor Pro 2 air-quality monitor: company ID in {0x2111, 0x2112, 0x2121, 0x2122}. Source: ble_monitor airmentor.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Air Mentor 2S
fleets.notes: Air Mentor 2S air-quality monitor: company ID in {0x5112, 0x5122, 0x6111, 0x6121}. Source: ble_monitor airmentor.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Blustream
fleets.notes: Blustream: company ID 0x0194. Source: ble_monitor blustream.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Beckett Genisys
fleets.notes: R.W. Beckett Genisys oil-burner controls: company ID 0x061A (SIG-assigned). Model keys are recovered only after a chained-XOR unwrap in the source parser, so this is a brand-level match. Source: ble_monitor beckett.py (MIT).

fleets.name: Jinou BEC07-5
fleets.notes: Jinou beacon BEC07-5: advertised service 0x20AA. Source: ble_monitor jinou.py (MIT).

fleets.name: ThermoPro
fleets.notes: ThermoPro probes/thermo-hygrometers advertise under their model names (TP357/TP358/TP359/TP393/TP96x/TP970 families). Sources: ble_monitor thermopro.py name dispatch and Bluetooth-Devices/thermopro-ble name prefixes (both MIT).

fleets.name: HolyIoT BLE tracker
fleets.notes: HolyIoT tracker form: service data under UUID 0x5242 (the catalog's HolyIoT Beacon fleet covers the separate 0x180A form). Source: ble_monitor holyiot.py (MIT).
